name: Reginald Kimball
source: Reginald Kimball is the son of a baron from the outskirts of the country. His family is renowned not for its wealth, but for its history. Reginald himself was sent to the academy to learn how to conduct himself in society and receive a good education as a future heir. Reggie himself has little interest in learning anything unless it ties into his dream of becoming a knight from the legends and fables he's admired since childhood.
